description: Generate textual descriptions of one or more images when the current session model (e.g. opencode/big-pickle) has no image input, by delegating to a vision-capable model on OpenRouter via `opencode run` with --file. Use when the user drops photos into imgs/, asks "can you read/describe these images", or an image needs a description for an article, portfolio, infographic, or video pipeline. Related terms: 看图, 描述图片, image description, vision model, glm-4.6v, --file.
